activation_rule: No open choice is activated by a fixture default or recommendation. Every vector supplies a named test policy profile.

decisions.topic: Installer grantor, viewer and radio scope

options.scoped_installer: Gateway admin grants a per-gateway entitlement. Radio visibility intersects current device/zone scope. Viewer+installer may survey/read only; radio writes also require writer role.
options.gateway_installer: Gateway admin grants entitlement over all gateway radio data/tools, independent of farm role; viewer+installer may use radio tools without farm-write rights.

decisions.recommendation_reason: Preserves the existing device-scope boundary while making installer authority explicit.

decisions.topic: Gateway owner admission and local proof

options.mapped_owner_or_admin: Enabled owner with durable ownership proof and confirmed local actor mapping, or current gateway admin; a mapped owner-as-viewer may use reboot/fan only.
options.mapped_admin_only: Every system-command actor, including owner, must also be a current enabled gateway admin.

decisions.recommendation_reason: Matches the recorded owner/admin product boundary while requiring an actual local actor. Neither option permits a missing mapping or caller-claim shortcut.

decisions.topic: Tolerated disconnected or stranded revocation exposure

options.edge_commit_only: Local sessions remain usable until edge account commit or finite token expiry; cloud shows pending/stranded explicitly. No bounded delivery guarantee.
options.bounded_offline_lease: Current authenticated edge authority has a finite lease; sessions fail closed after lease expiry if revocation delivery is unavailable. Phil must approve the production duration.

decisions.recommendation_reason: Bounds exposure even when the online gateway polling subject is disabled. CL2 should make installation-bound revocation delivery independent of a disabled human account; no lease duration is selected here.

decisions.topic: Prediction mutation authority for edge-backed zones

options.zone_write: Current enabled writer plus owned/granted zone for prediction-config, prediction-recompute and soil-profile refresh.
options.admin_zone_write: Same zone scope plus current gateway admin for these mutations.

decisions.recommendation_reason: Uses the canonical zone mutation gate without an owner short-circuit; jobs remain cloud-local unless a typed edge command is issued.

decisions.topic: Previously accepted reduce-only pause after requester loses authority

options.reduce_only_continuation: Apply a previously authorized, durable and actor/target-bound stop/pause after later loss of rights; record original actor. It can only disable/reduce watering, never open/re-enable or expand scope.
options.current_rights: Recheck current writer+zone scope at issuance and application; terminally refuse after loss, show policy may remain enabled and offer reissue by a currently authorized actor.

decisions.recommendation_reason: Lead recommendation: retain accepted stops without laundering authority into a new open or configuration write.

decisions.topic: First admin with scoped access off

options.stored_admin_bootstrap: New zero-user bootstrap stores admin in either flag. Existing no-admin installations use explicit operator recovery, never silent promotion.
options.operator_provisioned: Flag-off bootstrap retains researcher; operator must explicitly provision the first admin before Admin controls work. Existing installations use the same operator recovery.

decisions.recommendation_reason: Lead recommendation: fresh systems have a supported Admin entry while upgrades keep identities and last-admin protection.

options.durable_high_water: Use a durably persisted authorization-clock high-water mark for expiry; rollback cannot revive a token already expired at that mark.
options.reject_rollback: Refuse session use while wall clock is below the durable high-water mark until clock recovery; no revival.

decisions.recommendation_reason: Keeps valid sessions usable within their original bound without allowing expiry revival. Generation mismatch denies under either choice and at every clock value.

decisions.topic: Paired link-incarnation/credential-revision encoding, recovery and rollout. Required atomic semantics are fixed in v1; no legacy equal-version verifier replacement.
Actor/service envelope fields, capability rollout and legacy command disposition, including stop continuation proof. Missing actor is never inferred from owner.
